newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Thai Airways leases own freighter on BKK-F.
newsitem.headline: Thai Airways leases own freighter on BKK-F.

text.p: Thai Airways International Ltd said on Friday it plans to lease a Boeing 747-200 freighter for the Bangkok-Frankfurt route to take over one of two flights currently operated by partner Lufthansa Cargo.
But Thai Airways Scandinavia and Finland cargo sales manager Peter Sull said the move would not add more capacity.
"As soon as possible we'd like to start a jumbo freighter to Frankfurt and Los Angeles and a DC-10 for a regional operation," Sull told Reuters by telephone from Denmark.
He said this was Thai Airways' first step towards moving into the cargo sector with its own freighters.
The airline is aiming to set up an autonomous cargo division within the company, separate from the passenger divison, but no timetable has yet been set.
